Tata Sons board meeting postponed amid quorum and business concerns

A Tata Sons board meeting, initially scheduled for November 3, has been postponed to November 30. The postponement follows concerns raised by Tata Trusts chairman Noel Tata regarding quorum issues and the proceedings of a previous board meeting on September 17. The agenda for the upcoming meeting includes discussions on Tata Sons' loss-making businesses and potential IPO pricing, with experts noting that valuing unlisted entities like Tata Electronics, Air India, and Tata Digital will be a significant variable.
